question: Is bond distance a metric on every base? Census of the triangle inequality on parity bases, on bases of copies of each of the eight non-parity three-place languages, on not-all-equal bases whose knots meet at most once, and on not-all-equal tori.

definitions.bond: S with non-full projection and every (|S|-1)-subset projection full
definitions.bond distance: least bond holding both, minus one; infinite when none
definitions.failure: b(x,z) > b(x,y) + b(y,z) on three distinct distinctions, an infinite left side against a finite right side included
definitions.language: a three-place law up to reordering places and switching every value at once

public_inputs.reused: checks.py imports FREE-READ's freelib.py and the FREE-READ referee's referee_free.py as separate implementations

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: P1-P6 (with P3b) of research/BOND-METRIC-20261118-001/preregistration.md, scored by merge.py.
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py gates: separate bond searches, the planted violation, the exhibits of every language.

predictions.P1: parity bases: b satisfies the triangle inequality
predictions.P3: six languages (NAE, betweenness, clause, twisted clause, R6, twisted R6) fail on two knots on four distinctions
predictions.P3b: the two R5 languages: no failure within six distinctions and four knots
predictions.P4: pure NAE meeting at most once on seven distinctions: no failure
predictions.P5: pure NAE meeting at most once on eight distinctions with at most four knots: no failure
predictions.P6: every infinite failure under pure NAE has its long pair correlated (exact test)

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; read-out; proof; referee hand-off; report.
